text:
maria: Quick sync 5light-play6: want to pilot a pared-down playbook for short trials to cut claim noise and avoid full escalations. plan tomorrow AM.
eli: curious which borderline cases you want to catch vs ignore?
maria: keep it strict: trial_days <= 14, health_score < 0.6, recent_touches < 3, no manual owner claim. No SMS unless owner explicitly opted.
jordan-analytics: Add monitoring hooks pls. I9ll add metrics: `playbook_light_rate`, `escalation_rate_light`, `fp_rate_light`.
karen-enable: Micro-enable survey ok? 1 Q at T+3: "Was setup clear?" only if email deliverable and setup_completed == false.
eli: +1. Also skip for self-serve flagged accounts.
maria: draft config for ops: 
```
name: light-play
criteria:
  - trial_days <= 14
  - health_score < 0.6
  - recent_touches < 3
  - owner_claim == false
actions:
  - email: short nudge
  - in_app: help-tip
  - survey: optional micro (T+3)
  - sms: disabled
rollout:
  canary: 0.05
  week1: 0.25
  full: 1.0
qa_sample: 50
monitoring:
  - alert if escalation_rate_light > 0.02
```
sam-prod: FYI docs/UI copy needs an addendum about survey opt-in and owner-skip. I9ll open a small PR.
jordan-analytics: I9ll wire a dashboard and a daily probe that compares outcome vs classic playbook.
onboard-bot: Deploy scheduled: light-play v1 -> canary at 2026-03-25T15:00Z (deploy-id: dp-2468).
maria: rollout plan: canary 5% Tues 7am PT -> 25% Thurs -> check metrics + QA samples. rollback if fp_rate_light or escalation_rate_light spikes.
eli: cc legal for the micro-survey copy.
maria: thanks all. unless objections i9ll flip canary tomorrow. :thumbsup:
